findings.description: The requested lower-load rerun still exceeded the unchanged under-20-second locked-start target: a real Claude primary completed startup over 25 cold status logs in 30.047 seconds. Load averages were 53.86/45.26/49.17 at start and 46.25/44.28/48.69 at end. Lock and completion records matched the live Claude PID; the digest was complete, not truncated. The earlier recorded 17.258-second rerun and this failure demonstrate variability rather than reliable attainment. Diagnose that variability and obtain repeatable under-20-second end-to-end evidence before accepting the latency goal; this measurement alone does not isolate product cost from host scheduling.

summary: Eight live drain scenarios passed; the fresh lower-load locked-start check exceeded the required latency bound. No product source changes were made.
tested: `git diff --stat fd9b8b020201a029880b3980b545f352ae357a39 0ff4032e5f2c53734f51401d113177a73007a0a7` and scoped behavioral diff inspection.

`python3 /Users/charlesabrooker/.no-mistakes/evidence/01M4F9B87M5A8ZB6B0YDWF5A7V/round5-startup-driver.py` created a marked disposable lab home, enabled supervision-host, seeded 25 unprimed logs, and launched real Claude through a private 120x40 tmux primary with one invocation-local SessionStart hook running `bin/fm-session-start.sh --source startup`.

Captured monotonic startup elapsed time, load averages immediately before and after startup, the generated digest, live lock-owner process, and matching persisted completion PID; corrected the evidence driver to recognize only the emitted truncation banner rather than its mention in instructions.

`FM_HOME="$LAB" bin/fm-startup-network.sh wait 150`, `FM_HOME="$LAB" bin/fm-startup-network.sh report`, and `TMUX_TMPDIR="$LAB/tmux" tmux -L fm-lab kill-server` completed deferred-worker observation and isolated teardown; cleanup checks found no remaining current-run fixtures.
testing_summary: Baseline tool, Bash 3.2, and normal-login checks succeeded. Eight disposable-home drain scenarios passed, including adversarial cursor/read checks and flat cold-history fork growth. A real Claude locked startup completed in 30.05 seconds with start/end load below 60, failing the unchanged 20-second bound. CLI digests, fault/retry transcripts, metrics, and teardown evidence were saved; all current-run fixtures were removed. No full suite, lint, formatter, or other pipeline phase ran.
